title: Slice area formula and Tonelli: ∫_ℝ ∫_{Φ(S∩{w₀=t})} φ dHⁿ dt = ∫_S J'·φ∘Φ for an injective immersion Φ of ℝ^{n+1}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and S ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} Borel. Assume Φ is differentiable at every w ∈ S with injective derivative DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w, and Φ is injective on S. Let e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1, let w(0) be the 0-th coordinate of w, and J'(w) := (det[⟨DΦ(w)e_{i+1}, DΦ(w)e_{j+1}⟩]_{i,j=0}^{n−1})^{1/2} (Real.sqrt). Then for every Borel φ : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]: (a) t ↦ ∫_{Φ(S ∩ {w : w(0) = t})} φ dHⁿ is a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure on ℝ; (b) ∫_ℝ ∫_{Φ(S ∩ {w(0) = t})} φ dHⁿ dt = ∫_S ofReal(J'(w))·φ(Φ(w)) dw, the last integral with respect to Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝ^{n+1}. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] and all integrals are lower integrals in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), MeasurableSet S → (∀ w ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w) → (∀ w ∈ S, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) → InjOn Φ S → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ w in S, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i.succ 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j.succ 1))))) * φ (Φ w) ∂volume
